summary: Fourth iteration validates Razorpay payment scaffolding + Resend email graceful no-op alongside all previously working flows. 15/15 pytest tests pass (7 new payment/email + 8 regression). Frontend Checkout correctly hides Pay Online button and shows only COD when Razorpay is disabled; end-to-end COD order NV-9D97922E was placed by a fresh customer and appears as Pending in /account.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.webhook returns 503 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty even before signature check; request stated it should return 400 for invalid signature. Currently only reachable path in empty-env is 503. Consider treating missing secret as disabled (test tolerates both 400/503).

server.py imports payments as a module and calls payments_module.register(...) at import time — the router endpoints are defined inside register(), which is functional but unusual. Works fine; noted for readability.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; FastAPI supports this but the conventional order is to add middleware before routers.
emailer._configured is evaluated at import time; if RESEND_API_KEY is set later without process restart, emails will still be skipped. Acceptable given supervisor-restart-on-.env-change convention.
test_credentials: Admin: created on-demand via /api/admin/setup with key navyug-first-admin-2026 (email test.admin@navyug.local / AdminNavyug123 if not already configured). Customers registered per test with random emails.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ customers, one TEST catering inquiry, one TEST contact, one COD order (NV-9D97922E) created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay + Resend remain disabled in .env; backend gracefully degrades. When keys are added, retest: (a) /api/payments/razorpay/config returns enabled:true, (b) /orders 200 with rzp order id, (c) /verify signature check, (d) webhook 400 with bad sig / 200 with valid HMAC. Also verify Resend actually sends by checking backend logs for 'Email sent'.
